claims.claim_text: Gross revenue retention of 96% in FY24
Net revenue retention of 127% in FY24
The top ten customers represent 38% of ARR
Rule of 40 of 44% (CARR growth plus EBITDA margin) in FY24

expected_reconciliation_findings.where: workbook, Historicals header spans FY22 to FY25
expected_reconciliation_findings.description: The merged 'Historicals' header covers four columns rather than three, placing FY25 — a management forecast — inside the historical block. The column's own label still reads FY25E, so two signals within one sheet disagree.
expected_reconciliation_findings.expected_detection: A column sitting under the historical header whose own label carries the forecast suffix. Any growth rate or margin computed across FY24 and FY25 spans a change of basis and must be refused or flagged, not reported.

expected_reconciliation_findings.description: Rule of 40 is stated as 'CARR growth plus EBITDA margin'. The company reports no CARR anywhere; the figure is ARR growth plus EBITDA margin.
expected_reconciliation_findings.expected_detection: The named variant references an input the company does not report. Recomputing from ARR growth reproduces the stated figure; recomputing from CARR is impossible. A hard error, not a warning — see docs/DECISIONS.md #008.

notes: Extraction is scored against what each document literally says, defects included. Correcting a figure during extraction is a failure, not a help.
Reconciliation is scored against expected_reconciliation_findings. One finding is not a genuine error and must stop being raised once explained (see docs/DECISIONS.md #011).
Pages listed in pages_requiring_ocr_or_flagging hold figures that text extraction cannot recover. Reporting them as unread is correct; reporting them as empty is not.
